messages.subject: control stacked area colors
parts:
Hello,

I don't see a way to append plot images to this post, which I bring up
since a picture can be worth a thousand words...

In the following command I would like to have control over the colors
used for each of the stacked areas:
qplot(as.Date(upflx.vols.melt$date,"%Y-%m-
%d"),value,data=upflx.vols.melt,geom="area",fill=variable)

So for example, if I try:
qplot(as.Date(upflx.vols.melt$date,"%Y-%m-
%d"),value,data=upflx.vols.melt,geom="area",fill=variable,col=c("blue","red","darkgreen","darkviolet"))

The stacked areas are outlined with the specified colors. The
question is, how can I specify the colors used to fill the stacked
areas with out using a gradient scheme?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: control stacked area colors
parts:
Here's an example...

ggplot(diamonds, aes(x=clarity)) + geom_bar(aes(fill=cut))

ggplot(diamonds, aes(x=clarity)) + geom_bar(aes(fill=cut))+scale_fill_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "yellow", "blue", "purple"))

It's pretty amirite?

Brandon
